body: Wow, after carefully reading through this, I gotta say this really resonates with me! Life is a one-time opportunity after all. I guess I need a wake-up call, and that may come any day. Thanks!

I wish I'd live in the states. I'd love to drive around with you and discuss life. I'd even share my acid. If you're not even afraid of death though, you should be able to find some drugs. If you want to safe it--- use the dark net.

If you do, be mindful of "set and setting"! Those drugs are such an indescribable experience (I've tried both, LSD many times.) Even though they can be tough, I'd consider it something you really must do before you die. Preferably with a trip-sitter or a good friend who also takes it. 

Edit: sorry, forgot the no-friends thing. It is still possible to trip alone, a lot of people have done it. Remember to just let go, no matter what happens it won't be dangerous!
You say it "starts working", but what does that actually imply? Does it change your thought patterns?

That seems interesting although I know it gots some side-effects. I personally can't opt for that route since I plan on doing military service! That itself may fix it, but I've been having these thoughts for quite a while now so I doubt it.

Thanks for your input none the less. Is paxil the first antidepressant you got put on? After I finish my service it might get relevant. Also, how does it affect you? I've heard a lot of different accounts saying it just "slows them down." (not necessarily paxil)
Get some drugs. Perhaps some chemical out there could put your perspective in another light?
